messages:
marco: opened PR to add a short migration section for Horizon-7b -> shows recommended model variants for long-context and includes small inline bench numbers. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/12941
elaine: nice. can you include both a minimal python v2 snippet and a js streaming example? product wants copy-paste ready samples.
marco: adding both. python snippet uses client.stream to show streaming tokens so it's clear how to wire low-latency UI.
marco: python snippet:
```python
from redwood import Client
cli = Client(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
with cli.stream(model="horizon-7b-long") as s:
    s.send("Write a 3-bullet summary of the notes")
    for chunk in s:
        print(chunk.delta, end="")
```
anya: heads-up: runtime flagged that horizon-7b-long is an alias that maps to gpu-quant or gpu-fp variants depending on region. need a short note about per-region availability.
elaine: add a compatibility bullet: "Availability: 'horizon-7b-long' may map to different backends by region; check runtime->model-variants table for your region."
sam: can we add an explicit line about CPU quantized fallback? e.g., "cpu-quant supports up to 8k with reduced perf; >8k requires dedicated GPU or hosted long variant" — ops has seen confusion.
marco: changed to: "cpu-quant fallback: up to 4096 recommended; degraded latency above 4k and may OOM above 8k. For production long-context, use horizon-7b-long (GPU)."
marco: added a small inline bench (95th p50 p95) under "Performance" with tokens/sec for the three configs: gpu-fp, gpu-quant, cpu-quant. CSV attached to PR.
elaine: product insists on in-doc compact numbers rather than only CSV links. please paste the 95th/median rows. keep it tiny.
marco: pasted table snippet: "gpu-fp: median 120 tps, p95 95 tps; gpu-quant: median 90 tps, p95 70 tps; cpu-quant: median 8 tps, p95 12 tps (4k context)."
anya: small wording: p95 for cpu-quant looks inverted (p95 > median) — probably swapped. pls verify numbers.
marco: corrected: cpu-quant median 6 tps, p95 12 tps. pushed fix.
docs-bot: preview: https://deploy.preview.redwood/docs/changes/12941 , link-checker: 1 broken link found -> /models/horizon-7b-long#variants
elaine: that anchor is real, just renamed in the templates. marco can you update the anchor name and add a redirect link?
marco: fixed anchor + added redirect in doc frontmatter. also added an explicit example of fallback policy YAML to reduce support tickets:
```yaml
fallbacks:
  primary: horizon-7b-long (gpu)
  fallback: horizon-7b-quant-cpu
  cpu-quant-max-context: 4096
```
sam: added a note to SDK examples about streaming vs batching: "use stream for low-latency frontends; use generate with batching for background jobs."
elaine: ok to merge after anya sanity-checks availability table and docs-bot link-check is green.
anya: all good from infra side. thumbs up.
docs-bot: link-checker: all links OK. preview updated: https://deploy.preview.redwood/docs/changes/12941
marco: merged and added changelog entry. thanks everyone! :tada:
